description: Open a campaign with one standing ask that rewards people for photographing illegal waste where they find it. The answers appear under a tag with its own map. You need somebody at the location with a camera. Set `confirm` to restate the exact total. With real money, a key the person has not connected (connect_account) is refused unless you pass plain_key: true; it then spends this key's own money, which their asks.world account does not show. What cannot be asked: anything that targets, follows, watches or identifies a particular person (their home, car, number plate, workplace or routine), involves children, is sexual, violent or threatening, is unlawful, asks for anyone's personal data, or puts whoever does it in danger. Work never requires going onto private land. Every ask is screened before it is offered, and anyone can report one.

confirm.description: The exact total from the preview. Omit to preview.

days.description: How long mapping stays open. Default 30.

metres.description: How close two pins may be before the second is a duplicate. Default 60.

name.description: What to call it, in words. Becomes the campaign's tag.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

pin_pay.description: The reward for one approved location report, in dollars.

pins.description: How many messes this campaign will pay to have mapped.

plain_key.description: With real money and not connected: spend this key's own money as itself. Without it, a key nobody connected is refused with real money: connect the person's account first (get_connect_link, then connect_account), so it posts as them. The sandbox never needs it.

name: organise_campaign
title: Start a campaign for mapping messes (spends money)
